passages.text: Tephrocactus (from Greek tephra, "ash", referring to the color of these plants' epidermis) is a genus of the cactus family (Cactaceae).

Species
Species of the genus Tephrocactus according to Plants of the World Online as of October 2025:

Image Scientific name Distribution
 Tephrocactus abditus Argentina (Salta)
 Tephrocactus alexanderi Argentina.
 Tephrocactus aoracanthus Argentina.
 Tephrocactus articulatus Argentina.
 Tephrocactus bonnieae Argentina (Catamarca)
Tephrocactus molinensis Argentina (Salta)
 Tephrocactus nigrispinus Argentina, Bolivia, Chile
 Tephrocactus recurvatus Argentina (San Juan)
 Tephrocactus verschaffeltii Argentina, Bolivia
 Tephrocactus weberi Argentina (Salta).
